stops.note: borrowed, probably via Czech hejtman, for the Crown's army commanders; Hetman Stanisław Żółkiewski won the Battle of Klushino in 1610 and occupied Moscow
the elected Cossack leader; Hetman Bohdan Khmelnytsky's 1648 uprising founded the Cossack Hetmanate
used for Polish and Cossack commanders; Pavlo Skoropadsky revived the title as Hetman of Ukraine in 1918

current_meaning: a Cossack leader or Polish military commander
